description: Principal can execute code on the target via DCOM.

telemetry.detail: Network logon type 3 during DCOM activation.
Process create with an anomalous DCOM parent (e.g. mmc.exe/svchost spawning a shell).
DCOM lateral execution has recognisable parent-child chains (e.g. MMC20.Application -> cmd).

prerequisite_privilege: Local activation/launch rights on the DCOM object (usually admin)
abuse_primitive: Invoke a DCOM method that yields code execution.
notes: Less common than WinRM/SMB, so it can evade signature-based rules but stands out in parent-child process baselining.
